title: San Diego Comic-Con 2026: Marvel, Ramayana and Everything to Watch This Week
excerpt: From Marvel Studios' return to Hall H to Ranbir Kapoor presenting Ramayana: The Epic Begins, SDCC 2026 is packed with blockbuster reveals and panels running July 23-26.
body:
Key Takeaways
  • San Diego Comic-Con 2026 runs July 23-26 with major panels from top studios.
  • Marvel Studios returns to Hall H on Saturday with Avengers: Doomsday details.
  • Ramayana: The Epic Begins showcases in Ballroom 20, marking a historic moment for Indian cinema.
  • SDCC panels aren't livestreamed, but coverage is available through various outlets.
Comic-Con 2026 Highlights
›Dates: July 23-26, 2026
›Major Studios: Marvel, Apple TV+, Prime Video, HBO
›Key Panels: Avengers, Ramayana, Blade Runner
›Venue: San Diego Convention Center
  • San Diego Comic-Con 2026 runs July 23-26, featuring panels from Marvel Studios, Apple TV+, Prime Video, HBO and more.
  • Marvel Studios returns to Hall H on Saturday at 5:30 PM PT with Kevin Feige expected to reveal details on Avengers: Doomsday.
  • Ramayana: The Epic Begins gets an exclusive showcase in Ballroom 20 on Thursday with Ranbir Kapoor and Yash — only the second Indian film to secure a major SDCC hall.
  • SDCC does not officially livestream panels, but outlets like Popverse and IGN provide live coverage, and trailers typically drop online within hours.

The Biggest Pop Culture Event of the Summer

San Diego Comic-Con International kicks off this week with Preview Night on Wednesday, July 22, before the full convention runs Thursday through Sunday. After a quieter 2025, the 2026 edition is shaping up as one of the most loaded in recent memory — Marvel Studios is returning to its traditional Saturday night slot, Apple TV+ is making its first-ever Hall H takeover, and a historic Indian cinema showcase signals the convention's growing global reach.

> **"Popverse offers minute-by-minute live reporting for subscribers at $5.99 per month, while IGN, ScreenRant, and Collider will have reporters providing real-time updates."** ![Kevin Feige. Marvel Studios returns to Hall H on Saturday at 5:30 PM PT with Kevin Feige expected to reveal details on Avengers: Doomsday.](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/1/1a/Kevin_Feige_by_Gage_Skidmore.jpg)

Thursday: Percy Jackson, Ramayana and Gaming

Thursday opens with Disney's Percy Jackson and the Olympians in Hall H at 10:00 AM PT, promising an exclusive Season 3 first look. Marvel's Wolverine game from Insomniac Games follows at noon with never-before-seen PlayStation 5 footage and a confirmed September 15 release date. Paramount+ brings Avatar Aang: The Last Airbender at 1:00 PM, followed by the Big Bang Theory spinoff Stuart Fails to Save the Universe at 2:15 PM.

"Rama, a prince bound by duty, must face Ravana, an immortal ruler powerful enough to shatter the cosmos."

— Official SDCC panel description for Ramayana: The Epic Begins

The panel generating the most global buzz is Ramayana: The Epic Begins at 3:15 PM in Ballroom 20. Ranbir Kapoor, Yash, director Nitesh Tiwari, and producer Namit Malhotra — global CEO of Oscar-winning VFX house DNEG — will present the first international look at what is being billed as the largest cinematic undertaking in Indian film history.

Friday: Blade Runner, Lanterns and del Toro

Prime Video opens Hall H at 10:00 AM with Blade Runner 2099 and The Rings of Power Season 3. AMC follows with The Walking Dead: Dead City Season 3 and The Vampire Lestat. HBO's Lanterns panel at 1:30 PM features Kyle Chandler and Aaron Pierre alongside co-creators Damon Lindelof and Tom King. The Spaceballs sequel gets its moment at 4:00 PM, and Guillermo del Toro celebrates Pan's Labyrinth's 20th anniversary at 5:15 PM ahead of a theatrical 4K re-release.

Saturday: Marvel Studios and Star Trek at 60

Saturday is the marquee day. An animation block in Ballroom 20 brings Futurama, The Simpsons, American Dad, and Family Guy back-to-back. In Hall H, the Star Trek Universe panel at 12:30 PM celebrates the franchise's 60th anniversary with Anson Mount, George Takei, and Strange New Worlds Season 4 cast.

Ramayana's Historic Showcase
›Only second Indian film in major SDCC hall
›Ballroom 20 capacity: nearly 5,000 attendees
›Features score by Hans Zimmer and AR Rahman
›Part 1 release: Diwali 2026

Apple TV+ makes its first Hall H appearance at 2:00 PM covering Silo, Widow's Bay, and Dark Matter. Mike Flanagan's reimagining of Stephen King's Carrie follows at 4:45 PM with Amber Midthunder and Matthew Lillard.

The centrepiece is Marvel Studios at 5:30 PM. Kevin Feige will bring MCU stars, and expectations are enormous. Avengers: Doomsday banners are plastered across the convention, and with Spider-Man: Brand New Day hitting theatres the following week, exclusive footage is widely anticipated. After skipping SDCC in 2025, Marvel has ground to make up — the 2024 panel, where Robert Downey Jr. was revealed as Doctor Doom, set a nearly impossible bar.

Marvel's Anticipated Return
›Marvel's Hall H panel: Saturday at 5:30 PM PT
›Expectations high after 2024 reveal of Doctor Doom
›Exclusive footage of Spider-Man: Brand New Day anticipated

A Landmark Moment for Indian Cinema

For the Indian diaspora, SDCC 2026 carries particular significance. Ramayana: The Epic Begins is only the second Indian film to secure a major hall at Comic-Con after Kalki 2898 AD, and its Ballroom 20 showcase — accommodating nearly 5,000 attendees — puts it alongside Hollywood's biggest franchises. The two-part epic features a score by Hans Zimmer and AR Rahman, with Part 1 slated for Diwali 2026. Indian-American actress Poorna Jagannathan also features in the Lanterns panel, continuing the growing South Asian presence in major superhero properties.

How to Follow From Home

SDCC does not officially livestream panels. Popverse offers minute-by-minute live reporting for subscribers at $5.99 per month, while IGN, ScreenRant, and Collider will have reporters providing real-time updates. Trailers debuted in Hall H typically land on YouTube within hours. For Indian fans tracking the Ramayana panel, 3:15 PM PDT translates to 3:45 AM IST on Friday, July 24.
